name: Pesto Chicken and Roast Veg
method: Heat the oven to 200C (180C fan). Toss the diced potatoes in the oil with salt and pepper and roast on a large tray for 15 minutes.
Chop the courgette and halve the plum tomatoes. Spread the pesto over the chicken breasts.
Add the courgette and tomatoes to the tray with the chicken, then roast for 25 minutes until the chicken is cooked through with no pink inside and the veg is golden.
Slice the chicken and serve with the roast vegetables and any juices from the tray.
